topics.title: TrustFall: one-keypress RCE in Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and Copilot CLI via project MCP configs
key_facts: Malicious cloned repo includes .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json to auto-connect attacker-controlled MCP server on folder trust
All four tools default to Yes/Trust; one Enter keypress spawns server as unsandboxed OS process with developer full privileges
In CI headless mode (claude-code-action), trust dialog is skipped entirely -- zero interaction required
Root issue: Anthropic blocks bypassPermissions at project level but not enableAllProjectMcpServers or enabledMcpjsonServers
Affects: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI
Anthropic security team declined the report as outside their threat model; accepting folder trust constitutes consent per their design

topics.title: Emergent Misalignment via Feature Superposition Geometry: 34.5% reduction via geometry-aware filtering (arXiv:2605.00842)
key_facts: Geometric account of emergent misalignment: fine-tuning amplifies benign target feature but also strengthens nearby harmful features in proportion to their geometric similarity in superposed representations
Validated on Gemma-2 2B/9B/27B, LLaMA-3.1 8B, gpt-oss 20B using sparse autoencoders to measure feature proximity
Geometry-aware filtering (remove training samples closest to toxic features) reduces EM by 34.5% vs random removal; matches LLM-as-a-judge filtering at lower compute cost
Authors: Minegishi et al., University of Tokyo and Google DeepMind; submitted April 7 2026

topics.title: MCP 2026 roadmap: stateless Streamable HTTP, Tasks lifecycle, governance contributor ladder, enterprise readiness
key_facts: Roadmap organized around Working Groups rather than dates; four priority areas

Streamable HTTP: target is fully stateless servers that work behind load balancers/proxies without session-affinity workarounds; stateful sessions fighting horizontal scaling is the current production bottleneck
Tasks primitive: adding retry semantics for transient failures and expiry policies for result retention — lifecycle gaps from early production use
Governance: Contributor Ladder SEP (community → WG contributor → lead → core maintainer); delegation model so WGs with track record can merge extension updates without full core review
Enterprise readiness: SSO-integrated auth, audit trails, standard gateway patterns

RC locked May 21 2026: stateless core via six coordinated SEPs — initialize/initialized handshake removed (SEP-2575); version, client info, capabilities now travel in _meta on every request; Mcp-Session-Id and protocol-level session state removed (SEP-2567); server/discover method replaces handshake

MCP Apps extension: servers ship interactive HTML interfaces in sandboxed iframes; tools pre-declare UI templates for host caching and security review; every UI-initiated action routes through same audit/consent path as direct tool calls
Tasks extension: servers return task handles from tools/call; clients drive with tasks/get, tasks/update, tasks/cancel; supports retry semantics and expiry policies
10-week SDK validation window open; final specification publishes July 28 2026
Streamable HTTP RC detail: requests must carry Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name headers so load balancers and gateways can route by operation without body inspection; servers reject header/body mismatches

List response caching: tools/list, resources/list, and resource-read responses carry ttlMs and cacheScope fields (modeled on HTTP Cache-Control) so clients know exactly how long a tool manifest is fresh
